title: Female borrowers who specify the number of children may fund faster.
Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.
Female borrowers who mention securing their family's future may fund faster.
Female borrowers who specify the number of years the business has operated may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who include the specific loan amount in local currency in their pitch text may fund faster.
Male borrowers who mention contributing to the well-being of the local community may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention specific future goals like buying land or securing family may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention their age may fund faster.
Female borrowers who provide specific daily work hours may fund faster.
Male borrowers who mention specific tools or precise land measurements may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Mentioning the education of children predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention their past loan repayment history fund faster.
Female borrowers who explicitly thank the lenders in their pitch fund faster.
